page.overview:
Who is Star Gazer?

Star Gazer is a male background Earth pony with a light gray coat, brown mane and tail, gold eyes, and a cutie mark of a blue telescope with a white star. He has a speaking role in the episode For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils. He is unnamed in the show, credited only as "Audience Pony 2" in the closing credits of For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils, but is named in Adobe Illustrator Artwork file naming.__TOC__

Star Gazer shares his design, eye color, and accessory design with S04E19 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, shares his coat and eye colors and cutie mark with "Star Bright", shares his tail style, cutie mark, and sometimes eye color with Starry Eyes, shares his tail style and coat color with "Sightseer", shares his tail style and eye color with Perfect Pace, "The Tenth Doctor / Doctor Whooves #3", "Emerald Beacon", "Raggedy Doctor", and "Infinity", shares his tail style and sometimes eye color with Royal Pin, shares his eye color and sometimes tail style with "Earl Grey", shares his tail style with Compass Star, "Ponet", Madden, "Poppycock", S02E26 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #4, and "Jeff Trotsworthy", and shares his mane color with S04E22 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #3.

In the audio commentary of The Best Night Ever on the DVD My Little Pony Friendship is Magic: Season One Disc 4, Jayson Thiessen refers to Star Gazer as "the Carl Sagan pony" due to his resemblance to scientific author Carl Sagan.

The Adobe Illustrator Artwork files "MLP_FIM_CH_StarGazerRight_V01" and "MLP_FIM_CH_StarGazerRight_V02" each depict this pony.
